ja.title: Dato-DXdは同じ投与強度なら曝露も揃うか
ja.summary: 公開PopPKモデルから同総量・異なる投与間隔のADCとDXd曝露を比較する。有限期間AUC、後半平均、生成項の外挿を分け、有効性・毒性へ直接読み替えない。

en.title: Does equal dose intensity imply equal Dato-DXd exposure?
en.summary: Conditional simulations compare ADC and unconjugated DXd under equal total input. Finite-horizon AUC, late-window exposure and unvalidated formation-clock extrapolation are distinguished; clinical benefit is not inferred.
en.seo_title: Equal dose intensity and Dato-DXd exposure
en.seo_description: A public ADC model separates cumulative AUC, late-window means, peaks and formation-clock assumptions. Alternative intervals are unvalidated extrapolations.
